raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With HiCache `write_back`, an eviction copies its victims to the host pool with `transfer_kv_all_layer_mla_lf_pf` (MLA KV and the DSA indexer), and the scheduler waits for that copy. The op takes a `block_quota` argument (workgroups launched, default 2). On MI355X the default caps this copy at about 22 GB/s; 16 workgroups reach about 49 GB/s. There is currently no way to change it without editing the call sites.

## Modifications

- `environ.py`: new `SGLANG_HICACHE_BACKUP_BLOCK_QUOTA` (`EnvInt`, default unset).
- `pool_host/common.py`: `hicache_backup_copy_kwargs()` returns `{}` when unset and `{"block_quota": N}` when set.
- `pool_host/mla.py`, `pool_host/dsa.py`: the one `transfer_kv_all_layer_mla_lf_pf` call in each passes `**hicache_backup_copy_kwargs()`.
- Unit test for the helper: `test/registered/unit/mem_cache/pool_host/test_hicache_backup_block_quota.py`.

Default behaviour is unchanged: when the variable is unset no extra argument is passed, so the kernel default (2) applies and backends whose op has no `block_quota` argument (e.g. the XPU shim) are not affected. MHA host pools are not touched in this PR.

## Accuracy Tests

The grid size only changes how items are split across warps (each warp owns a disjoint item range, no cross-warp communication), so results must not change. Checked on a v0.5.22-based build (MI355X, GLM-5.2-MXFP4):

- Microbenchmark in the production shape (KV: 20 layers x 576 B, DSA indexer: 5 layers x 8,448 B, one eviction = 75 nodes): output is byte-identical to the default for every `block_quota` from 1 to 64, and host memory outside the target rows keeps its sentinel value (no out-of-bounds writes).
- Capped-pool gate (device pool limited to 300K tokens per rank so evictions are continuous and a second 16k x 128 pass loads the host copies back), with `SGLANG_HICACHE_BACKUP_BLOCK_QUOTA=16`: GSM8K 200-prompt probe 0.985 with 0 garbled outputs, long-context needle 64/64, long-prefix GSM8K 62/63.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Same build, 1 prefill (TP1 x PP4) + 1 decode (TP4/DP4), AgentX trace replay at concurrency 104, 1 hour:

- Copy of one eviction (~6.5 GB): 278 ms -> 125 ms (quota 2 -> 16).
- Time per eviction summed over the four PP ranks: 1.45 s -> 1.04 s.
- Throughput 49,719 -> 51,374 tok/s/GPU (+3.3%; mean of two runs vs one run, both with the same other settings).

Limits: measured on one GPU type (gfx950) and one model. I do not know the best value on other GPUs, hence an opt-in environment variable rather than a new default. The code change was validated on the v0.5.22-based build; on current `main` I checked that the files import and the helper behaves as above, but I could not run the end-to-end benchmark on `main`.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code (`ruff format`, `ruff check` pass on the changed files).
- [x] Add unit tests.
- [ ] Update documentation (these `SGLANG_HICACHE_*` variables are not documented elsewhere).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results.

files.patch:
@@ -877,6 +877,10 @@ class Envs:
     SGLANG_HICACHE_HF3FS_CONFIG_PATH = EnvStr(None)
     SGLANG_HICACHE_DECODE_OFFLOAD_STRIDE = EnvInt(None)
     SGLANG_HICACHE_SKIP_HOST_DUPLICATE_RECLAIM = EnvBool(False)
+    # Workgroups launched by the all-layer device->host KV copy that backs up a write_back
+    # eviction (MLA KV and the DSA indexer). Unset keeps the kernel default (2); a larger
+    # value raises the copy bandwidth on GPUs where 2 workgroups cannot saturate the link.
+    SGLANG_HICACHE_BACKUP_BLOCK_QUOTA = EnvInt(None)
     SGLANG_HICACHE_FILE_BACKEND_STORAGE_DIR = EnvStr(None)
     # File-backend LRU eviction (opt-in; sizes accept SI/IEC suffixes, "0" disables).
     SGLANG_HICACHE_FILE_BACKEND_MAX_SIZE = EnvStr(None)

@@ -27,6 +27,16 @@
 _HOST_LOCKED_RANGE_ATTR = "_sglang_host_locked_range"
 
 
+def hicache_backup_copy_kwargs() -> dict:
+    """Extra kwargs for the all-layer device->host backup copy (``block_quota``).
+
+    Empty unless SGLANG_HICACHE_BACKUP_BLOCK_QUOTA is set, so the kernel's own default
+    (and any backend whose op has no such argument) is left untouched.
+    """
+    quota = envs.SGLANG_HICACHE_BACKUP_BLOCK_QUOTA.get()
+    return {} if quota is None else {"block_quota": quota}
+
+
 class HostTensorAllocator:
     def __init__(self):
         """Initialize the HostTensorAllocator."""

@@ -25,6 +25,7 @@
     ALLOC_MEMORY_FUNCS,
     _cuda_host_unregister,
     get_allocator_from_storage,
+    hicache_backup_copy_kwargs,
     make_kernel_ptr_table,
 )
 from sglang.srt.platforms import current_platform
@@ -485,6 +486,7 @@ def backup_from_device_all_layer(
                         item_size=self.indexer_page_stride_size,
                         dst_layout_dim=self.indexer_layout_dim,
                         num_layers=self.layer_num,
+                        **hicache_backup_copy_kwargs(),
                     )
             else:
                 raise ValueError(f"Unsupported layout: {self.layout}")

@@ -0,0 +1,24 @@
+"""SGLANG_HICACHE_BACKUP_BLOCK_QUOTA only adds ``block_quota`` to the backup copy when set."""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.pool_host.common import hicache_backup_copy_kwargs
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestHiCacheBackupBlockQuota(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_unset_leaves_the_kernel_default(self):
+        with envs.SGLANG_HICACHE_BACKUP_BLOCK_QUOTA.override(None):
+            self.assertEqual(hicache_backup_copy_kwargs(), {})
+
+    def test_set_passes_block_quota(self):
+        with envs.SGLANG_HICACHE_BACKUP_BLOCK_QUOTA.override(16):
+            self.assertEqual(hicache_backup_copy_kwargs(), {"block_quota": 16})
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
